items.docs: Full-text search across over 20 million historic American newspaper pages digitized under the National Digital Newspaper Program. Supports keyword search, date range filtering, state filtering, and newspaper title (LCCN) filtering. Responses are available in JSON or Atom format.

items.docs: Search for newspaper titles in the Chronicling America collection by name, location, LCCN, language, and date range. Returns bibliographic metadata for matching titles.
